user_stories.title: Create reproducible application workspace while preserving prototype
acceptance: Pin compatible Node/pnpm/dependencies after checking official release documentation; frozen lockfile install works in clean container with TypeScript, Next.js, Drizzle, Zod, Better Auth, Vitest/Playwright/Storybook.

Root scripts expose lint, typecheck, test:unit, test:integration, test:e2e, build, check:i18n and check:security; service credentials are synthetic test values. Local compose provides isolated PostgreSQL/Redis/mail capture.

Use explicit build context/copy allowlist: no PDFs, prototype, .git, .sdlc, automation, private corpus or credentials in learner image. Existing prototype files remain unchanged and runnable as reference.
Provide server shell and health readiness contract; no admin, algorithm, lab, billing or coach implementations. Handoff transfers layout ownership to UI task and manifests remain leased to DevOps.

This dependency-free infrastructure bootstrap runs only after exact-plan approval and under explicit existing infrastructure authorization. Add nonempty shell/health/smoke and configuration tests for baseline scripts; do not claim these test the later identity features.

user_stories.title: Configure application CI and controller prerequisites through protected review
acceptance: Propose protected patch for real SaaS CI and staging adapter configuration, without weakening existing gates, changing founder identity, budgets or release scope. Separate trusted founder acceptance of protected paths is mandatory before integration; this plan approval does not self-authorize that patch.

Configure checks.application_configured=true only after real checks.application entries, commands and gates.required_application_status_checks match application-ci.yml and run nonempty bootstrap smoke suites. Job runs frozen install, lint, types, unit/integration, browser E2E, build, localization and dependency/security checks with isolated services. No continue-on-error, empty suites or prototype/infrastructure checks count as SaaS feature success.

Ensure bot PR/current-head check reconciliation and combined candidate CI are exercised by trusted controller; preserve infrastructure checks. The initial workspace/CI bootstrap uses existing infrastructure gates plus independent clean local app checks; after configuration is accepted all subsequent app integrations require registered current-head application checks.

Define protected staging adapter interface, candidate SHA/image digest and evidence output. Keep credentials out of manifests and prompts. Unconfigured adapter or required check must fail closed, never be replaced by a placeholder success.

Current CLI rejects every non-infrastructure story while application checks are unconfigured, including lead/UX. Therefore OPS-001 and OPS-003 are explicitly infrastructure bootstrap tasks and run first; no proposed exception or policy weakening is used. Policy changes invalidate the computed plan approval: after protected patch acceptance the trusted controller must recompute/reapprove exact plan against new policy before ordinary application dispatch.

user_stories.title: Implement identity database and protected auth API
acceptance: Use pinned established auth adapter for email/password, verification/reset, Google/GitHub, secure sessions/revocation and safe verified account linking; no custom crypto. Library bridge remains under /api/v1/auth.

Create reviewed ordered migrations for user/profile, provider account, session, verification/reset and audit entities only. Fresh DB and seeded-account upgrade tests pass with separate migration/application roles; no future progress/grant tables.

Validate request/config with Zod; typed safe error envelopes, server authorization on every protected endpoint, CSRF/origin/callback state checks, strict CSP and secure cookie controls. Protect anonymous auth with atomic shared rate limits and signup bot safeguards; Redis outage fails closed with retryable errors.

Captured-mail tests cover valid/expired/replayed verification/reset, session expiry/revoke, duplicate signup, OAuth state/error/linking collisions and concurrency. Logs/events exclude email addresses, passwords, tokens, answers and sensitive bodies; audit records use minimal pseudonymous IDs.

user_stories.title: Build translated shared UI and complete authentication journeys
acceptance: Implement ui_ux auth flows and all loading/empty/invalid/offline/expired/error/retry states; signup → inbox → verify → sign-in and request → reset → sign-in work with real backend.

All labels, accessibility names, errors, bot challenges and mail subjects/bodies resolve English translation keys; missing-key and pseudolocalization tests pass. Translate library errors through safe mapping.

Provide shared accessible primitives, four track colour tokens, system/light/dark preference with readable first paint and 320px-to-desktop responsiveness; keyboard and screen-reader journeys work without pointer input.

Unit/component/Storybook and Playwright evidence covers auth forms, navigation, focus, OAuth cancel/provider outage, mail retry/rate limits, and theme contrast; live provider evidence remains assigned to staging verification.

user_stories.title: Deliver skippable onboarding, private profile and truthful dashboard
acceptance: Server-session-owned profile reads/updates accept validated background, level, goal, optional calendar date and locale; skip stores explicit skipped state; edit/reload and concurrent update conflict handling preserve data.

New verified learners see onboarding once or skip to empty dashboard. Dashboard shows separately labelled no-owned-labs/no-completions/no-mastery, empty review/weakness/streak/readiness states with no invented scores, disabled product promises or imported content.

Clear next action is complete/edit profile. Protected deep links safely return to intended internal page; dashboard-to-profile is one action. Reserve continuation slot for M3 without claiming active-lab resume is delivered.

Unit/integration/E2E cover every background, enum/date validation, skip/save/update, unverified/anonymous denial, cross-user attacks, loading/error/retry preserving inputs, events and <60-second onboarding usability measurement.

user_stories.title: Add minimal account export/deletion and consent foundations
acceptance: Provide reauthenticated owner-only export of M1 personal data and confirmed account deletion with sessions revoked, personal provider/profile/token records removed, minimal audit retention documented; unauthorized or cross-user calls fail.

Only essential session/theme storage enabled by default; optional analytics remains disabled without consent, no model training or coach data pipeline. Explain retention/backups and deletion replay after restore using translated copy.

Test export schema/ownership, recent-auth requirement, deletion idempotency and post-delete session denial. Database deletion transactions use existing schema; any new migration requires explicit lease transfer back to schema owner.

user_stories.title: Deploy exact candidate to isolated staging and exercise recovery
acceptance: After separately accepted protected changes and configured operator prerequisites, build/deploy an exact integrated candidate to HTTPS staging; record commit, image digest, environment, migration ID, timestamp and health checks. No production deployment.

Use managed secrets, least-privilege runtime/migration roles, isolated Postgres/Redis/mail, monitored structured logs/errors/traces and daily encrypted backup policy. Learner image/network has no development-control-plane access.

Run fresh and populated migration, actual backup restore into isolated DB and old/new compatible rollback; record recovered account/session behaviour and deletion suppression. Stop writes and restore backup on incompatible migration rather than blindly running down migrations.

Provide staging URL, real email sender and Google/GitHub callback readiness, fault-injection checks, alerts/runbook, target 99.9% monitoring and performance profile. Missing host/provider/budget configuration remains outstanding; no fake deployment evidence.

ui_ux.states: UX.md specifies each screen and loading/empty/invalid/error/success transitions, focus and recovery. All UI/email/a11y strings are keys.
ui_ux.responsiveness: 320px phone, 768px tablet, 1280px desktop; no horizontal page scrolling, hover dependence or inaccessible controls. Physical phone and desktop staging review required.
ui_ux.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA; visible focus, 24px minimum targets or compliant spacing, adequate text/non-text contrast, labels/error associations, status live regions, reduced motion and no colour-only signals.

delivery_tasks.ownership: Exclusive paths per story; shared leases and serial handoffs in DELIVERY.md. Proposed paths are not current worker authorization. QA is read-only under current runtime; listed report paths are destinations for trusted controller/lead persistence, not permission for QA to mutate its workspace.
delivery_tasks.estimate: 11 bounded story contracts at 20 worker-minutes each = 220 first-pass implementation minutes; independent reviews and external setup add time. Decompose before dispatch if a story cannot fit 20 minutes; do not bypass attempt limits. Material plan changes require revised exact-plan approval.
delivery_tasks.budget: $22 first-pass allocation, up to $44 for two attempts across 11 stories; independent reviews, extra bounded sessions and hosting excluded. Not a hard provider spending cap. Total programme budget/project controls unresolved before paid dispatch.
